verdict.rationale: Sill is a remote-display and remote-control app that shows a Mac window or desktop on an iPhone or iPad. It has no AI agent or tool-using component, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product category rather than a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI, agent or MCP capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
